{{Quote|There's bad news and good news. The bad news is that we're the Hawk-bats, and we're going to take your starfighters and blow up some ground facilities with them. But the good, news is that we really do have fresh caf for you in the mess.|Kell Tainer to Milzin Veyn's wingman|<ref name="X-Wing: Iron Fist" />}}
This '''unidentified individual''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[TIE/ln space superiority starfighter/Legends|TIE Fighter]] [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]] and the [[Wingmate/Legends|wingman]] of [[Lieutenant/Legends|Lieutenant]] [[Milzin Veyn]]. They were assigned as the escort of the fueling [[Tanker/Legends|tanker]] [[Bastion (tanker)|''Bastion'''s]] escort but were captured then detained by members of [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] [[Commando/Legends|commando]] [[Squadron/Legends|unit]][[Wraith Squadron]], who at that time were posing as the [[Hawk-bat Independent Space Force]].<ref name="X-Wing: Iron Fist" />
